keywords: Unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference
root_cause: Driver dereferenced an uninitialized device pointer or client struct in interrupt/probe context.
remediation: Add NULL pointer check before accessing struct member
Verify devm_kzalloc allocation return code in driver probe function
Enable CONFIG_DEBUG_RODATA and CONFIG_KASAN in kernel defconfig to catch uninitialized reads

root_cause: I2C slave peripheral held SDA line LOW or clock stretching exceeded hardware controller timeout.
remediation: Implement I2C GPIO recovery sequence pulsing SCL 9 times
Verify 4.7k ohm pull-up resistors on SDA and SCL lines with digital oscilloscope
Check peripheral device power rail sequencing to prevent warm-reset lockups

root_cause: System-wide RAM exhaustion triggered Android Low Memory Killer (LMK) to terminate foreground app.
remediation: Inspect native memory bitmap allocations and ensure recycle() is invoked
Enable zRAM swap compression or increase minfree thresholds in sysfs

root_cause: Application attempted to pass data buffer > 1MB across Android IPC Binder transaction buffer limit.
remediation: Store large datasets in local SQLite/Room database or file cache instead of Binder Parcel
Pass URI or file descriptor reference through Intent rather than inlined byte array
Refactor IPC interface to stream payload in chunks < 64KB

root_cause: SoC thermal sensor breached critical junction temperature limit (typically > 85°C).
remediation: Inspect thermal interface material (TIM) and heatsink mounting torque
Enable CPU DVFS throttling policy in device tree thermal-zones node
Check kiosk chassis airflow and ambient operating environment specifications

root_cause: SPI DMA transfer attempted with non-cacheline-aligned memory buffer on ARM64.
remediation: Replace stack buffers with dma_alloc_coherent() or kmalloc(..., GFP_DMA | GFP_KERNEL)
Align buffers to 64-byte L1 cache boundaries using __aligned(ARCH_DMA_MINALIGN)
Ensure proper dma_sync_single_for_cpu/device flushes around DMA transfers
